parties.respondent: Haryana State Industrial Development Corporation Ltd. & Anr.

summary: Plot allotment cancellation due to non-compliance with conditions; appellant failed to show concrete steps for project implementation despite multiple show-cause notices; infrastructure deficiencies claimed by appellant insufficient justification given extended time; HSIDC justified in resuming plot after five years of inaction; natural justice principles followed through multiple notices; allotment cancellation upholds industrial promotion objectives.
legal_provisions_cited: Indu Kakkad v Haryana State Industrial Development Corporation Ltd, 1999 (2) SCC 37
Managing Director, Haryana Industrial Development Corporation & Ors. v Hari Om Enterprises & Ors, 2009 (16) SCC 208
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; NCDRC judgment allowing HSIDC's revision petition upheld; HSIDC's cancellation of plot allotment maintained.
